maddeler.t: Derived from د (d), and originally written as such (in rasm) by analogy with Nabatean tradition, as Nabatean cognates of Arabic words with /ð/ were indiscriminately spelled using 𐢅 (d).
g: The ninth letter of the Arabic alphabet, called ذَال (ḏāl) and written in the Arabic script; preceded by د (d) and followed by ر (r).

maddeler.t: Derived from د (d), and originally written as such (in rasm) by analogy with Nabatean tradition, as Nabatean cognates of Arabic words with /ð/ were indiscriminately spelled using 𐢅 (d).
g: The twenty-fifth numeral symbol of the Arabic alphabet (traditional abjad order, used for list numbering), written in the Arabic script; preceded by خ (ḵ) and followed by ض (ḍ).
